# nginx

Launch and configure an NGINX HTTP server.

Automatically generates an `nginx.conf` with configurable workers, CPU affinity,
NIC queue count, keepalive, gzip, and optional SSL support (use the `ssl` tag).
Also configures IRQ affinity for the server NIC if `NGINX_IRQ_AFFINITY` is set.

Tags:
- `ssl`: enable SSL with a self-signed certificate

Usage:
```bash
%import@server nginx NGINX_NWORKER=8 NGINX_PORT=80
```

Source: [`modules/nginx.npf`](https://github.com/tbarbette/npf/blob/main/modules/nginx.npf)

## Variables

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `NGINX_NWORKER` | `16` | Number of worker processes |
| `NGINX_PORT` | `8188` | Listening port |
| `NGINX_GZIP` | `off` | Enable gzip compression: on or off |
| `NGINX_ROOT` | `./nginx/` | Document root directory |
| `NGINX_USER` | `www-data` | User to run NGINX as |
| `KEEPALIVE` | `30` | Keepalive timeout in seconds |
| `NGINX_SSL` | `1` with `ssl` |  |
| `NGINX_CPU_STEP` | `1` | CPU core step for worker affinity |
| `NGINX_DAEMON` | `on` | Run NGINX as a daemon: on or off |
| `NGINX_IRQ_AFFINITY` | `1` | Set NIC IRQ affinity to match workers |

```{collapse} Late variables

Late variables are evaluated after the variables above.

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `NGINX_SRVTYPE` | `default_server`<br>`ssl` with `ssl` |  |
| `NGINX_SERVER_CONFIG` | *empty*<br>`ssl on;ssl_certificate nginx-selfsigned.crt;ssl_certificate…` with `ssl` |  |
| `NGINX_SSL_CIPHER` | *empty* |  |
```
